next_question: Does iterative decompression correctness hold for streaming incremental decompression where the proxy forwards partial chunked frames without full body reassembly, such that the decompressor processes chunk boundaries incrementally at realistic CDN chunk sizes (8KB+) and multi-layer encodings?
why_next: The audit-identified V1_BUFFERED_PROXY_NOT_STREAMING (inherited from parent EXP-RUNTIME-35495699298) is now the highest-upside unresolved blocker. All tested decompression paths buffer the full upstream body before re-chunking and reassembling before decompressing. Chunk boundaries never intersect a compression layer. If the pipeline fails on partial-frame forwarding at realistic CDN chunk sizes (8KB+), the CDN correctness gate becomes moot because real CDNs serve chunked without guaranteeing a contiguous body. Streaming decompression is materially orthogonal to the localhost-buffered multi-layer correctness just established: it tests a different architectural property (incremental vs batched processing) rather than repeating the same question with different parameters. A positive result unblocks the CDN gate; a negative result identifies a critical infrastructure gap that must be fixed before CDN testing is meaningful.

recommended_action: Design a streaming incremental decompression experiment where the proxy forwards partial chunked frames without full body reassembly, testing whether iterative decompression (brotli->gzip->identity, max_depth=5) produces byte-identical output to ground-truth when chunk boundaries are fed incrementally. Use the validated high-entropy payload generators from EXP-RUNTIME-35495699298 and EXP-RUNTIME-35513777099. Test at realistic CDN chunk sizes (8KB) as well as the established chunk_size=32. Include multi-layer stacked encodings (GZIP-THEN-BROTLI, BROTLI-THEN-GZIP) to exercise incremental decompression across both layers. If streaming passes, the CDN correctness gate is unblocked. If it fails, diagnose whether the failure is in the incremental decompression state machine, chunk-boundary dictionary references, or cross-layer state contamination. After streaming decompression is validated, the next step is real CDN infrastructure testing (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai free tier with Accept-Encoding negotiation, auth-aware cache/Vary).
